title: Love, Marriage, Sex, and Dishes: Setting Boundaries in Romantic Relationships
coreMove: Romantic boundaries protect closeness by turning guesses into spoken limits around arguments, dishes, sex, privacy, and care, with follow-through both partners can understand.

exampleSpecs.audience: partners who turn chores into quiet tests
exampleSpecs.stakes: A hosting plan will become resentment unless dishes and labor get named.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use a compact message exchange to turn dishes and household labor into shared terms.

exampleSpecs.audience: partners who soften a no under pressure
exampleSpecs.stakes: A loving text thread can turn into consent pressure if the refusal gets negotiated.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show the protagonist stopping a smoothing habit and restarting with sex, consent, and a body limit.

exampleSpecs.audience: couples whose conflicts sprawl into old history
exampleSpecs.stakes: Repair will disappear if one rent talk becomes a whole relationship trial.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use one close, quiet moment to show one subject protecting repair in an argument.

exampleSpecs.domain: bakery shift after a weekend fight
exampleSpecs.audience: partners sorting labor resentment after the fact
exampleSpecs.stakes: The same chore fight will repeat unless the evidence turns into shared terms.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Open after the outcome and reconstruct how dishes and household labor lost shared terms.

exampleSpecs.domain: road trip fatigue and motel pressure
exampleSpecs.audience: partners who notice pressure in their own mouth
exampleSpecs.stakes: A no will be respected or turned into a bargain before the drive resumes.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Center the moment the protagonist notices his own consent pressure and corrects it.

exampleSpecs.domain: laundromat planning before a guest conflict
exampleSpecs.audience: partners who need a written cue before conflict
exampleSpecs.stakes: A Sunday guest argument could either repair one issue or reopen several old ones.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Let a written memo carry the one-subject argument rule into repair.
